scope: Refresh-resilient, account-bound pending E2EE recovery activation with browser storage fault handling

controls.wrapping_key: non-extractable Web Crypto CryptoKey stored by IndexedDB structured clone
controls.storage_write_failure: memory-only continuation with explicit do-not-refresh warning

threat_model_note: A non-extractable CryptoKey co-located with ciphertext prevents plaintext/export accidents; it is not represented as protection from compromised same-origin JavaScript or XSS.

resolved_findings.finding: IDBRequest.onsuccess can occur before its transaction commits, allowing a false refresh-safe UI claim if the transaction later aborts.
resolved_findings.resolution: The state store now resolves only at transaction.oncomplete and rejects on transaction.onerror/onabort; a success-then-abort regression test is required.

resolved_findings.finding: A browser store can survive logout and expose a pending activation to a different Nexus account.
resolved_findings.resolution: The account commitment is stored and authenticated in AAD; a mismatch clears the state fail-closed.

external_release_gates: real-device IndexedDB lifecycle lab under trusted HTTPS
formal independent production cryptography and XSS review

capacity.reason: Goal reports usageLimited; bounded local implementation with one sequential independent checker
